subject: CatalystAI discovery — mutual action plan & decision timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sasha King <sasha@catalystai.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@catalystai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: CatalystAI discovery — mutual action plan & decision timeline

Hi Sasha & Liam,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap so we have shared expectations and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please flag anything I missed.

Attendees (today):
- Sasha King (VP Product, CatalystAI)
- Liam O'Neill (Head of ML, CatalystAI)
- Ben Carter (Account Executive, Redwood Inference)
- Priyom Das (Solutions Engineer, Redwood)

Top pain/goals you described:
1) High inference costs and unpredictable spikes as model usage scales (goal: reduce per-inference unit cost 30% vs current infra).
2) 95th%-tile latency spikes during peak batch jobs (goal: consistent p95 < 120ms for async API).
3) Security/data controls for PII in logs and auditability for SOC2 (goal: evidence & private deployment option).

Proposed MAP (high level) — milestone, owner, target date:
- Live demo of Dedicated topology + KV caching (owner: Priyom) — target: Tue Jun 22
- Provide SOC2 artifacts & security questionnaire (owner: Kimberly) — target: Fri Jun 26
- Pilot kickoff (2-week scoped pilot: up to 1M tokens/day, standard eval prompts) (owner: CatalystAI + Redwood SRE) — target: Mon Jun 29
- Procurement & SOW review (owner: Mike Patel / Catalyst procurement) — target: Thu Jul 8
- Decision / go/no-go (vendor selection, sign SOW) — target: Fri Jul 16

Ask from you this week:
- Confirm demo time on Jun 22 (suggesting 11:00am PT) and who should attend from your infra/security team.
- Share procurement contact for SOW routing (if different than Mike).

Attachments: Catalyst-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones & owners), SOW-draft.pdf (initial commercial terms).

Notes on scope: our pilot proposal focuses on inference throughput/latency targets and end-to-end metrics we can run against your standard prompts. We'll provide a short cost model based on your current token volumes and expected batch patterns.

If all good, I’ll push the v1 MAP to a shared Google Drive and start scheduling the demo.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
(415) 555-0197

Thanks Ben — that looks right to me. A few quick clarifications:

- Decision committee: I'll be the product sponsor; Liam will own technical validation; procurement (Mike Patel) will drive contractual sign-off. We also want security (Anika Rao, our InfoSec) to be in the SOC2 evidence review.
- Demo: Jun 22 at 11:00am PT works for us. Please include a short segment (10–15m) showing failover/fallback behavior and how you route to lower-cost variants.
- Cost ask: Can you provide a modeled estimate for 1M tokens/day across a mixed sync/async workload? We need a quick ballpark to present to finance.

I’ll loop Mike (procurement) separately, but his contact is mike.procure@catalystai.com.

- Please prepare a Dedicated demo with a short script: 1) cold start & latency baseline, 2) KV cache demonstration with repeated prefixes, 3) failover to cheaper variant (show routing policy). Keep the demo 25–30 minutes.
- Bring an ops slide for autoscaling behavior under burst.

Kimberly:
- Pull SOC2 artifacts + the security questionnaire responses. Start assembling a redacted bundle we can share with Catalyst's Anika. Target to get that to Sasha by Fri Jun 26.
- Build a quick cost model for 1M tokens/day (sync/async mix). Use conservative batch sizes and show per-token cost delta for quantized vs fp16.

I’ll coordinate calendar invites and include Prod/Sec from Catalyst once Sasha confirms attendees. Attach: MAP v1 and SOW-draft for your reference.

Ben

1) Demo confirmed — Tue Jun 22, 11:00am PT (Google Meet link in invite). Priyom will run the Dedicated demo and show the fallback flow. Please include Anika (InfoSec) if she wants to join the SOC2 portion.

2) Updated MAP (highlights):
- Demo: Jun 22 — owner: Priyom (Redwood) — outcome: technical validation + list of follow-up todos
